headline: GE HealthCare Technologies (GEHC) Beats Q2 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
summary: GE HealthCare (GEHC) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +8.65% and +0.41%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
